description: Lifelong NH resident, State Representative, and Merrimack native. I attended local public schools before earning my Bachelor’s in Business ('24) and Master’s in Strategic Leadership ('25) from New England College. Today, I serve you in Concord, work as a NH Realtor, and coach college wrestling. Since you elected me in 2024, I’ve fought to keep our town safe and prosperous. With your support this November, I’ll keep making your voice heard.
title: Adam Presa For State Representative | Merrimack | Merrimack, NH, USA
